Webviews should use onWillMoveEditor
Currently Webviews (and by extension custom editors) require the input to know what group they're being opened in to handle the moving of the webview without a re-render. I recently added `onWillMoveEditor` for notebooks to handle this case. This should be adopted to remove the dependency on knowing about the group.
I’ll trace the webview/custom-editor move lifecycle and replace the group-dependent handling with the editor move event, then run the focused checks.

Implemented.

- Webview panes now release their overlay on `onWillMoveEditor`, so the target can claim the existing webview without re-rendering.
- Removed the cached group from webview/custom-editor inputs and serialized state.
- Resolve/deserialization positions now derive the containing editor group directly.

Validated with `tsc -p src/tsconfig.json --noEmit` and `git diff --check`.
